command.start: Start a game or movie night in this channel
command.startName: A short name for this night
command.duration: Hours before an unfinished night expires
command.allowMultiple: Allow every member to submit multiple nominations
command.nominate: Nominate a choice for the active night
command.choice: The game or movie to nominate
command.close: Close voting and pick the winner

guildOnly: Night voting is only available in a server.
unavailable: This night vote is no longer available.
title: {kind, select, movie {**Movie Night: {name}**} other {**Game Night: {name}**}}
multipleNominationsLimited: Nominations per member: one (moderators can add more)

error.active-session-exists: This server already has an active night vote.
error.duplicate-nomination: That choice has already been nominated.
error.invalid-duration: Duration must be between 1 and 24 hours.
error.invalid-kind: Choose either a game night or a movie night.
error.invalid-name: Names must contain visible text and be no longer than 80 characters.
error.nomination-limit: This night vote already has five nominations.
error.not-creator: Only the host or a moderator can do that.
error.not-found: There is no active night vote here.
error.not-nominating: This night vote is no longer accepting nominations.
error.not-voting: Voting is not open for this night.
error.own-nomination-exists: You have already submitted a nomination for this night.
error.too-few-nominations: At least two nominations are required before voting can open.
error.wrong-channel: Use the channel containing the active night board.
